rows.en: Ymir: "Oh, so this is where everyone was."
Fain: "Ymir!"
Ymir: "Congratulations, Fain.
You're officially a pilot now."
Fain: "Yes! I, Fain Jin Barion,
shall fight with my life on the line!"
Emy: "Big Siiis!"
Emy: "Why are you running away?"
Ymir: "H-hahahaha..."
Fain: "Why don't you stop clinging to Ymir
and do some studying?"
Emy: "You have no right to tell me that!
I certainly don't want to hear it
from someone so far beneath me."
Fain: "What?!"
Emy: "Ooh, how scary!"
Ymir: "I-I'm sorry...
She doesn't mean... Well, maybe she does, but really...
That's just the way she is..."
Emy: "Ooh, how cruel!
But I won't let a little thing like this discourage me.
After all, this too is your 'love,' Big Sis..."
Touya: "...This is the headquarters of the alchemists, right?
Is this really one of their chosen elite candidates?"
Arthur: "You mustn't judge people by appearances.
I hear she's an exceptional talent who has already earned
her scholar's degree at her young age.
They say that if Ymir succeeds Lady Ivel,
she'll become Chief Scholar."
Emy: "Hmph!"
Touya: "I see. So she's Ymir the Second..."
Emy: "D-don't call me the Second!
Big Sis just happened to come before me!"
Fain: "Hmm.
But if there's already a precedent, then you are the Second."
Emy: "I said, don't call me the Second!"
Fain: "The Second, the Second, the Second, the Second!"
Emy: "Ugh..."
Fain: "The Second, the Second, the Second, the Second, the Second..."
Emy: "W-waaaaaaah!"
Fain: "Heh... Justice triumphs!"
Touya: "...What are you, a pair of kids?"
Clovis: "Anyway, didn't you have something to tell us?"
Ymir: "Oh, yes. There was a little trouble,
but Lady Alforina's funeral will be held tomorrow."
Ai: "I see..."
Ymir: "Everyone here, Prince Lodis,
Prince Tix, Lady Ivel, Chairman Rakbal,
Lord Garyud and the others from York
will be attending the funeral."
Touya: "That's all?"
Ymir: "We can't make it too public..."
Arthur: "Some people would want to read something
into the relationship between the Holy Land and York."
Melvi: "...Hey, did somebody die?"
Touya: "Oh, right. We hadn't told you, Melvi.
The thing is..."
Melvi: "No... That's so sad... Hic, hic..."
Touya: "H-hey..."
Melvi: "Ugh... Sob... Hic...
It's so sad... Sob, sob..."
Ymir: "Melvi. It's all right to cry for her,
but if all you do is grieve, she won't be able to go to heaven."
Melvi: "...Huh? Really...?"
Ymir: "Yes. Now, wipe your tears.
We have to give her a proper send-off."
Melvi: "...Okay."
Ymir: "There, there. That's a good girl."
Melvi: "...Thank you for the meal."
Yamato: "Whew! I'm stuffed.
...But it looks like Ymir's in the lab again today."
Melvi: "Yeah... She said she just couldn't get away..."
Touya: "I see... If only there were something I could do to help..."
Paldia: "That's kind of you. But what you need
to do right now is eat plenty
and get some rest.
Ymir is working hard to make things easier for you
in battle. You need to make sure you're ready
to do your part in return."
Touya: "Oh..."
Paldia: "Now then, I need to do that, and this... Let's see..."
Touya: "Huh? You seem happy.
Did something good happen?"
Paldia: "Huh? D-do I? Do I look
that excited?"
Yamato: "Yes, very."
Paldia: "Actually..."
Melvi: "Oh! Tomorrow's the day Daddy comes home!"
Touya: "Daddy... You mean Forzen?"
Melvi: "Yeah!"
Touya: "R-right... Hm? Wait, come to think of it..."
Forzen: "Well then, I still have a little business to attend to,
so I'll take my leave here.
Ai, I'm leaving the rest to you."
Touya: "Don't tell me he's bringing someone else back again..."
Paldia: "Who knows? We'll find out tomorrow.
Now, Melvi, you'd better go to bed
so Daddy can see you bright and cheerful tomorrow."
Melvi: "Okaaay. Good night, then."
??: "Unfortunately, it looks like Rayblade
will remain in the Holy Land's custody."
Ioannis: "Oh, so that's the extent of your influence."
??: "Things seldom go as we wish.
I am making an effort, you know."
Ioannis: "My, my, how feeble.
Well, you're the only one I can rely on.
Those people over there are no use."
Render: "..."
Resh: "Tch... You stay somewhere safe yourself...
Anyone can talk..."
Ioannis: "...Hm? Did you say something?"
Resh: "Nothing!"
Ioannis: "That won't do... I heard you perfectly well.
Who do you think is giving you support?
If you dislike it so much, I can cut it off, you know."
Barkin: "!!"
Resh: "Hah! So we're supposed to worship you for it?
Don't insult me..."
Barkin: "Stop. You're going too far."
Resh: "H-hey... You're going to stay quiet after he mocks us like that?
Say something! Normally, you'd..."
Ioannis: "Hahahaha! Barkin seems
to understand very well.
Resh, you should learn a little from him. Hehehehe..."
??: "Now, as for what comes next... The Spirit Mechs themselves
are no problem, but that pilot, Touya, seems to require attention.
He isn't a threat yet, but that day is drawing near."
Render: "Is that her assessment?"
??: "Yes. Apparently that's how she felt after seeing him herself."
Resh: "He must be something to make her say that."
Render: "!! A-are you all right?!"
??: "Ugh... Again..."
Render: "Here, your hand..."
??: "Don't interfere!"
Render: "...?"
Render: "You must be tired.
Perhaps you should rest a little..."
??: "Yes, I think I will..."
Ioannis: "Then I'll be going too.
Do try your best, gentlemen."
Resh: "...Hey, Barkin.
Why did you decide to join
≪Dawn of an Era≫?"
Barkin: "Wh-what brought this on...?
Well... To bring a new order
to this rotten world..."
Resh: "It's just you and me here.
I'm not asking for a textbook speech
full of platitudes. I'm asking why."
Barkin: "..."
Resh: "...I... My father was in charge of research
to prove the usefulness of ≪Ze=Ode≫...
But back then, public opinion was still strongly
against using ≪Ze=Ode≫, so it was done in secret.
Then... news of the research leaked,
and my father was forced to take all the blame.
Heh... What you'd call a scapegoat.
After that, wherever we went, life was hell for us...
People looked at us with contempt. At worst, they even threw stones
into our house. The strain got to Mom, and before long...
Even my little sister could have been saved if she'd seen a doctor...
But the bastards said they had no medicine for the likes of us..."
Barkin: "..."
Resh: "The people who put us through that are now
openly trying to make use of ≪Ze=Ode≫...
With the backing of the state!
...That's why I joined.
To take revenge on this rotten world, where people
don't even hesitate to hurt others to protect themselves..."
Barkin: "You... Why are you telling me this?"
Resh: "Why, I wonder? I don't know myself.
But you're the first person I've ever told."
Barkin: "Y-you won't get anything out of me by saying that!"
Resh: "I'm not expecting anything.
But don't go doing anything rash."
Barkin: "...What do you mean?"
Resh: "The orphanage."
Barkin: "H-how do you know about that?!"
Resh: "I happened to find out the other day. How long has it been?"
Barkin: "..."
Resh: "I see... Well, if you don't want to talk..."
Barkin: "...Five years. My younger sister
entrusted a little boy to me then, and died."
Resh: "...Was he your sister's child?"
Barkin: "She didn't say anything. But Gina was
so responsible. She wouldn't have just run away from Limberg.
And if she'd been pregnant, she would have told me."
Resh: "Limberg? You're from Zigrim, aren't you?"
Barkin: "I sought asylum there. A long time ago.
My sister worked as a lady-in-waiting at the palace there.
I think that boy Demi's mother is from Limberg's
royal family, or holds a comparable position..."
Resh: "So you think she got caught up in royal family trouble?
Do you have any evidence?"
Barkin: "I don't know. I'm looking into it."
Resh: "So that's why you left the boy at an orphanage
and have been supporting it..."
Barkin: "Yeah. But don't tell anyone."
Resh: "I know. We're friends, aren't we?
Besides... You're an idiot, but there's nobody
I get along with like you."
Barkin: "H-hmph! That's creepy!
I'm not into that sort of thing."
Resh: "Heh... I'm not into that either."
Barkin: "...But, well...
I don't mind having a drink with you... You know."
Resh: "...You just can't be honest, can you?
Admit you get along with me."
Barkin: "Hmph!"

review_batches.context: Read all 214 rows and surrounding Holy Land/early-route members. Ymir congratulates Fain, Emy's affectionate pestering becomes second-Ymir teasing, funeral arrangements are announced, Melvi grieves, and a separate dinner scene discusses Ymir's work and Forzen's return.
review_batches.decisions: Emy's Big Sis is an affectionate address, not a claim of blood kinship or sexual content. Chief Scholar is the literal shorter source title, not proof of a new rank distinct from earlier forms. Alforina's funeral is tomorrow within this scene, not current real-world chronology. Ymir's heaven reassurance is her comfort to a child, not verified cosmology. Three punctuation-only rows use the explicit timed-ellipsis object, preserving every wait control.
